comment.hr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Amandman 6. poništen je iz tehničkih razloga. </translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.da:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Ændringsforslag 81 blev annulleret af tekniske årsager. </translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.el:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Διάφορα</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Η τροπολογία 6 ακυρώθηκε για τεχνικούς λόγους. </translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.it:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Varie</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
L'emendamento 6 è stato soppresso per ragioni tecniche. </translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sl: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Razno</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Predlog spremembe 6 je bil razveljavljen zaradi tehničnih razlogov.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diversos</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
A alteração 6 foi anulada por razões técnicas. </translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.mt:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Varji</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
L-emenda 6 ġiet annullata minħabba raġunijiet tekniċi. </translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.cs:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Různé</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Pozměňovací návrh 6 byl zrušen z technických důvodů. </translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.sv:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Övrigt</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Ändringsförslag 6 hade strukits av tekniska skäl. </translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.lv:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Dažādi</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Grozījums Nr. 6 bija atcelts tehnisku iemeslu dēļ. </translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Aon ghnó eile</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
Rinneadh Leasú 6 a chealú ar chúiseanna teicniúla </translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.es: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Varios</title><remarkFreeText><translation>La enmienda 6 ha sido anulada por razones técnicas.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.fr:
<remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Divers</title><remarkFreeText><translation>
L'amendement 6 a été annulé pour des raisons techniques. </translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
